apply_mod(hub,hbev)

dots=[]
h=0.35; a=0.8; sr=(a*a+h*h)/(2*h); cz=16.0+h-sr
for i in range(12):

vs=body.data.vertices

        e.select=True; mouth.append(e)

rbev=bpy.ops.mesh.bevel(offset=0.3,segments=3,affect='EDGES',clamp_overlap=True)
bpy.ops.object.mode_set(mode='OBJECT')
if 'FINISHED' not in rbev: raise RuntimeError('Socket mouth round failed')

tri=body.modifiers.new(TAG+'_triangulate','TRIANGULATE'); apply_mod(body,tri)
mesh=body.data

nonman=sum(1 for e in bm.edges if not e.is_manifold)

tris=len(mesh.polygons)

rad=max(math.hypot(v.co.x,v.co.y) for v in mesh.vertices)
mid=[v.co for v in mesh.vertices if 4.0<=v.co.z<=12.0]
widths=[]
for i in range(6):

    pr=[p.dot(u) for p in mid]; widths.append(max(pr)-min(pr))

if 'FINISHED' not in res: raise RuntimeError('STL export failed')
